title: Related resources response
description: The 200 body of GET /wp-json/resource-hub/v1/related/{id}?count=n, the plugin's related-resources route. count is 1 to 10 and defaults to 3; a count outside that range or an id that is not a public resource is answered with a WordPress REST error (wp-error.schema.json). The body lists IDs only, by design: the front end then reads the full objects with GET /wp-json/wp/v2/resources?include={ids}&orderby=include&_embed, so one code path renders a resource everywhere and this route stays small and cacheable.

items.description: The related resources in display order, hand-picked ones first and then those sharing a topic. At most 10, never more than count, and never including the resource itself. Empty when nothing is related.

item.description: One related resource: its post ID and why it is here.

id.description: The post ID of the related resource, to pass to the core collection's include parameter.

source.description: Why this resource was selected: pick means an editor chose it for this resource, topic means it shares at least one resource_topic term and was chosen by the plugin's related query.
